decisions.reason: The multi-model compliance line with nearly 200 agency templates represents substantial sunk investment, fits the announced compliance and agency direction, and has received positive customer feedback, so management persists with it, especially after already having withdrawn its flagship B.

The configurable managed plan is close to the core offer, cheap to run on the owned container infrastructure, and supports the scalable-hosting promise, so absent clear evidence of failure the firm keeps it.

Extended PHP security support was launched only recently, reinforces the secure and compliant operations the firm promises, and any weak uptake can still be attributed to the early phase, so withdrawing it now would be premature.
